settings.hero_desc: A tall, sculptural floor vase with a sleek hourglass silhouette, finished in clean white. A minimalist statement piece for lobbies, entrances and luxury interiors - made to your size and finish.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your shape, size, finish and colour
settings.s1_body: This oversized floor vase makes a quiet, confident statement - a smooth hourglass form finished in clean white, scaled to command a lobby, entrance or living space. Use it as a sculptural centrepiece or a dramatic vessel for tall stems. We build it to your shape, size and finish.
settings.case_body: Created as a sculptural statement, this oversized vase anchored the space with its clean form and scale - a minimalist centrepiece that elevated the entrance without crowding it.
settings.case_quote: Such an elegant, striking piece. It gives our lobby a real sense of calm and luxury.
settings.prov_p: A single, oversized form can define a space more than any cluster of decor. Clean lines and confident scale make a quiet, luxurious statement.
